title: docs(skills,docs): teach "the person is a record", a membership key with valueField 'id'
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xGhQ9Vps3zMMNeKgfPxy1Zn)_

Fixes #31176

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

A `skills/**` diff ships in `@objectstack/skills`, so this PR adds `.changeset/data-skill-person-is-a-record.md` (`'@objectstack/skills': patch`, both declaration lines), not `skip-changeset`. `dispatch-gates` mandates the contract-review model tier for `skills/**` (clause ①); that mandate is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03), and this card ran on the project's default model. The dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review. The docs page `content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx` is in scope by the card itself (triage 6710238236 folded it into the `domain:skills` lane).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据技能 `rules/security.md` 的成员键一节、它的 eval（新增 case 14）和 RLS 指南 `rls.mdx` 教会「人即记录」：`employee` 名册声明 `my_employee_ids: { userField: 'user', valueField: 'id' }`，`leave_request` 的策略写 `employee in current_user.my_employee_ids`；并纠正技能里「`valueField` 不能是 `id`」的旧说法（PR #31174 后已不成立）。
- 为什么改：#31129 裁定 A 已在 PR #31174 落地，但技能和指南仍说 `id` 被拒，AI 作者会继续给每行加 `owner_id` 或建联接表。
- 风险与回滚：只改教学文字、一个 eval 用例、两份 changeset 和 security.md 一行棘轮上限（3698 → 3768，按常设裁定 6513306068 实测抬高，先删了 3 行指针）；不动任何运行时代码；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` § Membership keys 的 diff（策略块两行注释 + 一条 policy、`valueField` 行、新 bullet、Choose-by 改写）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`（退出 0，security.md 3768 / 3768）；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`（需先构建，见下方门禁）。
- 需要你做的：`check-governed-merges` 判为 GOVERNED，Tier H（`skills/**` ×2）：需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 的批准（或亲手合并），席位契约复审 ACCEPT 后再由席位落地。

## What it teaches, and where each sentence comes from

| Taught sentence (site) | Code on `main` |
|:--|:--|
| `valueField` is a reference column, or `id` (security.md § Membership keys; rls.mdx) | `packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts` L740-L741 ("F is a reference column on X … or `id`, the roster row's own primary key (#31129 ruling A)"); `packages/lint/src/validate-membership-key-declarations.ts` L245 `isRosterOwnId`; explanation `membership-key-value-field-invalid` (`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` L1783-L1794: "F may also be `id`, X's own primary key") |
| never the same column as `userField` (stated beside the code, not attributed to it) | rls.zod.ts docblock "`valueField` naming the same column as `userField`" — refused by the schema's own superRefine, so `membership-key-value-field-invalid` never fires for it; rule-explanations L1793 "F may not be U's column: the schema refuses that" |
| roster `employee`, `my_employee_ids: { userField: 'user', valueField: 'id' }`, policy `employee in current_user.my_employee_ids` (security.md policy block; rls.mdx os:check block; eval 12) | rls.zod.ts L742-L745; rule-explanations L1838-L1840; `.changeset/31129-membership-key-own-rows.md` example |
| with `id` the set is the ids of the caller's own roster rows | rls.zod.ts L742 "With `id` the set is the caller's own rows of X"; rule-explanations L1789-L1790 |
| it grants nothing by itself | rls.zod.ts L747 "It grants nothing by itself: what a policy grants with it is the author's." |
| tested against a column not referencing the roster, or another object's `id`, the policy is refused (`rls-predicate-membership-key-target`) | `packages/lint/src/validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.ts` L1868-L1872 (an `id` key's target is the declaring object), L1486-L1488 (`id` of another object faults), L1492-L1496 (non-reference / other-reference faults), L1667 `severity: 'error'`; rule-explanations L1830-L1834 |
| compared with a column that references the roster, or the roster's own `id` (rls.mdx) | rls.zod.ts L745-L746; enforceability hint L1674 |
| "a named record (the caller's own roster row too) → a membership key"; "the user → owner scoping" (security.md Choose-by) | re-scope of the existing choice rule so it does not contradict the new case ("the person → owner scoping" read as covering the person-as-record) |

## The diff, file by file

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` § Membership keys: a two-line variant in the existing policy block (comment naming the `employee` roster and its key, then an `own_leave` policy on `leave_request`); the policy block's comment says "in a permission set" (it now holds a non-portal policy); the `valueField` line says "or `id` (`membership-key-value-field-invalid`; never the same column)"; one new bullet on what an `id` key holds and does not do; the Choose-by bullet re-scoped. The os:check object block above is byte-identical.
- **Correction of a false claim in the claimed file:** `valueField` "(never the same column, nor `id`: `membership-key-value-field-invalid`)" was false after PR #31174; the "nor `id`" is gone.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`: case 14 (below). Swept the file: no case rewards the old "nor `id`" claim (case 6 is the account roster, unchanged).
- `content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx` § Context variables: the `valueField` sentence names "a reference column, or `id`"; a paragraph **When the person is a record**, an `os:check` block (`employee` roster with `my_employee_ids`, `leave_request` (`public_read`) with an `employee` lookup, an `employee_self_service` permission set with `own_leave`), and a paragraph on what the key compares with, the refusal code and "grants nothing by itself", and why `leave_request` is `public_read`: RLS only narrows what the org-wide default already allowed (the same page, § How policies compose), so under `private` the policy would narrow the employee's own rows and a request someone else filed for them would stay hidden. Picked `public_read` (review S3) so the policy is what scopes the rows.
- `.changeset/data-skill-person-is-a-record.md`: new, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.
- `.changeset/data-skill-optional-master.md` (**deliberate touch**, seat ruling): this unreleased note from this lane's PR #31092 said "the membership-key notes say a `valueField` cannot be the roster's own `id` (`membership-key-value-field-invalid`)"; that clause is deleted so the next release notes do not print both claims. Nothing else in the file changes.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: security.md's row only, 3698 → 3768 (below).

## Token budget

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, `ceil(bytes / 4)`:

- `origin/main` (bdefd49f): 14783 bytes → 3696 tokens, ceiling 3698 (headroom 2).
- After: 15069 bytes → 3768 tokens.
- Deletions (each a whole line, never a rewrap), 208 bytes = 52 tokens:
  - D1 `- Source: \`node_modules/@objectstack/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts\`` (§ RBAC). Fact held: that path only. Home: `skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md` L18 (same path, with its exports).
  - D2 `- Source: \`node_modules/@objectstack/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts\`.` (§ RLS). Fact held: that path only. Home: `references/_index.md` L47.
  - D3 `- Source: \`node_modules/@objectstack/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts\`` and its blank line (§ Sensitive fields). Fact held: that path only. Homes: `references/_index.md` L13, `rules/field-types.md` L31.
- Remainder after the cuts: 3768 − 3698 = **+70**. Raised by the measured remainder, pinned at the measurement, under the standing ruling recorded as 6513306068 (maintainer ruling 2026-10-27, decision card 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」, tap A), verbatim: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」. The seat ruled the cuts and the raise before the script was touched. No other row changes.
- Eval fixtures and docs pages are not ratcheted.

## Eval case

`hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 14:

- prompt: "In our HR app each `employee` record has a `user` lookup to the person who signs in. An employee may read only their own `leave_request` rows (each has an `employee` lookup), and we don't want an owner stamp or a junction table for it. Call the set `my_employee_ids`."
- must_contain: `membershipKeys`, `my_employee_ids`, `valueField: 'id'`, `employee in current_user.my_employee_ids`
- must_not_contain: `using: 'owner_id` (matches an owner-scoped policy, not an answer that names owner scoping as the thing to avoid)

## Other sites

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-1.mdx` L285 says a `valueField` "that is not a reference" is refused. It is the v18.1 release history, true when written; left alone (seat ruling).
- No other skill names `membershipKeys` or `valueField` for a membership key. The generated reference pages (`content/docs/references/security/rls.mdx` L174, `references/data/object.mdx` L461) already say "or `id`".

## Gates

Head `ebb6bce9` = the card commit `b9f4ec22`, a merge of `origin/main` (`42252a5a`, reviewed: contract review PASS, no must-fix) and one review delta commit (S1, S2, S3, N4, N6, N7). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived the same 87 commands at `b9f4ec22` and at `ebb6bce9`, after a full `pnpm build` (exit 0). Each ran under `timeout 900` with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`, exit captured before any pipe. At `ebb6bce9`: **86 exit 0, 1 exit 1** (`check-empty-changeset`, the deliberate correction below; it stays red by design until the seat's record confirms it). ## Review delta (`42252a5a` → `ebb6bce9`)

- S1: security.md's `valueField` line reads "or `id` (`membership-key-value-field-invalid`; never the same column)", so the code is no longer pinned on the same-column case (the schema refuses that itself). Same bytes: 15069 → 3768 tokens, ratchet row unchanged.
- S2: eval 12's prompt names `my_employee_ids`; `must_not_contain` is now `using: 'owner_id`, which an answer naming owner scoping only as the thing to avoid does not match.
- S3: rls.mdx's `leave_request` is `public_read`, with the reason stated (RLS only narrows the org-wide default).
- N4: the rls.mdx `valueField` sentence reads "(`valueField`: a reference column, or `id`)". N6: table row cites L1667. N7: the new changeset says the platform change is in this same release.

## Merge of `origin/main` (`ebb6bce9` → `0a8ff459`)

PR #31201 added eval cases 12 and 13 to the same fixture, so this card's case is now **case 14**, content unchanged; the merge (plain merge commit, parents `ebb6bce9` and `85c01247`) resolves only that file. At `0a8ff459`: JSON parses, ids 1–14 unique; `check-skills-token-ratchet` exit 0 (security.md 3768 / 3768); `check:skill-examples` exit 0 (286 examples, after rebuilding spec/client/client-react on merged main); `check:skill-identifier-liveness` exit 0; `check-commit-card-trailers` exit 0.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION of a pending release note

`check-empty-changeset` names `.changeset/data-skill-optional-master.md` (present on the merge base, changed here). This is not a collision: that note, from this lane's PR #31092, is unreleased and says a thing this PR's teaching makes false. Corrected sentence, before:

> The `relationship/master-detail-required` lint row names the optional master, and the membership-key notes say a `valueField` cannot be the roster's own `id` (`membership-key-value-field-invalid`).

After:

> The `relationship/master-detail-required` lint row names the optional master.

Nothing else in that file changes. Per the gate, the dispatching seat confirms this by its own record (ACCEPT / same-head contract-review PASS); it is not restored from the base, which would republish the false clause.
